sys.setrecursionlimit(1 << 25)
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()
index = 0
t = int(data[index])
index += 1
results = []
for _ in range(t):
    n = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    a = list(map(int, data[index:index + n]))
    index += n
    max_sum = max(a) * n
    results.append(max_sum)
print('\n'.join(map(str, results)))
